name: GTA Holdings Berhad
overview: GTA Holdings Berhad 今年在 ACE Market 完成 IPO，并与 Safran Helicopter Engines Asia 签署谅解备忘录，为在马来西亚设立 Helicopter Engine Accessory Repair & Training Centre 进行 Makila 2 发动机 LRU Level 4 能力的技术转移讨论。公司业务线未披露其他扩张、缩减或合约公告。
overview_en: GTA Holdings Berhad completed its IPO on the ACE Market this year and signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Safran Helicopter Engines Asia to discuss technology transfer for Makila 2 engine LRU Level 4 capability in connection with a proposed Helicopter Engine Accessory Repair & Training Centre in Malaysia. No other expansion, reduction, or contract announcements were disclosed for its business lines.
